race.comment: IRON FURY (6) kept fresh for this and is unlucky not to have a few more wins on the CV. Savaged the line with the 59.5kg when a desperately unlucky third over 1200m at Scone. Key jockey change from a good gate and has genuine claims. AUTUMN FLYER (3) carved out solid figures at his second race start with a dominant victory over 1100m at Wyong. Looks to have more to offer as he stretches out in distance. CLASSIC POCKET (5) two runs back have had merit and indicated a win was imminent when third over 1100m at Wyong in a fast run contest. Tempo suits and will be charging late. VITTOZZI (13) was taken to the front last start and showed good fight over the final 150m when second over 1200m at Kembla Grange. Maps well and stays in contention. The chances don't end there.
